title: Localization yields the sector gap μ-almost everywhere
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, C ∈ 𝒟_2(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ 2), Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P with orthogonal projection π = Q.starProjection, a, e ∈ ℝ^P, R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P (IMRep univ 2) representing C (R.Represents C), μ := R.measure, and s > 0. Write f(x) := arctan(⟨x,e⟩/⟨x,a⟩) and q(x) := x − πx. Assume the localization property Loc(s): for every s' ∈ (0, s] and every x ∈ spt C with ⟨x,a⟩ > 0, ||x| − 1| < s', |f(x)| < s' and |q(x)| ≤ 2s|x|, one has |q(x)| < (s'/4)|x| and |x − a| < 3s'. Then for μ-a.e. x ∈ ℝ^P: if ⟨x,a⟩ > 0, ||x| − 1| < s and |f(x)| < s, then |q(x)| < (s/2)|x| or 2s|x| < |q(x)|.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (s : ℝ), R.Represents C → 0 < s → (∀ s' : ℝ, 0 < s' → s' ≤ s → ∀ x ∈ C.support, 0 < inner ℝ x a → |‖x‖ - 1| < s' → |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s' → ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ ≤ 2 * s * ‖x‖ → ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s' / 4 * ‖x‖ ∧ dist x a < 3 * s') → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, 0 < inner ℝ x a → |‖x‖ - 1| < s → |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s → ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s / 2 * ‖x‖ ∨ 2 * s * ‖x‖ < ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖
